blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A lawmaker still believes that the 20 percent discount for purchases made by senior citizens should still apply to goods and services that are under promotional offers or value added tax (VAT) exemption. This view is expressed even as the Supreme Court (SC) ruled that only one type of incentive shall be applied. In a statement on Friday, Senior Citizens party-list Rep. Rodolfo Ordanes said that since promotional offers are given to consumers regardless of age, a special discount for senior citizens should still apply. “We maintain that senior citizens must continue to enjoy their statutory 20% discount and […]...
